what: Only on the first open in a tab, a white circle (160px, phone 100px) with a logo on top (80px, phone 56px) stands in the middle of the accent-color curtain. After 1s the page opens behind the curtain (fx:open), and 2s after that the circle bursts to twice the screen height (200vh) in .6s ease while the logo vanishes. The curtain lifts 1s later than that, in .4s, and fx:done fires. From the second time in the same tab no curtain is shown, and fx:open and fx:done fire directly after 1s.

options.[data-fx-part=logo]·[data-fx-part=circle: Center logo and white circle (both optional — without the circle, only the logo disappears)
options.start: Time from raising the curtain to opening the page (seconds), default 1
options.hold: Seconds from page open until the circle starts to grow, default 2
options.grow: Duration (s) for the circle to grow and the logo to disappear, default .6
options.fade-at: Seconds from page open until the curtain starts to lift, default 3
options.once: If none, the veil is shown every time it opens (default session — once per tab)
options.key: sessionStorage name when shown only once, default fx-circle-burst

use: — Hero entrance via document.addEventListener("fx:open", …) delayed by 3.5s like the original
note: The original only adds a class with jQuery, and lengths and delays live in CSS transitions (.js-loading 3s late, .4s · circle and logo 2s late, .6s). The 200vh circle diameter is the value the original chose so it covers the corners even on wide landscape screens. On app screens with frequent navigation, shorten start, hold and fade-at, or leave once as is.

from.where: shared.js · shared.css .e-loading (original .js-loading — is-active 1s after load, the Hero image 3.5s after that · title lines at 5.1s)
